title: Test the persist writer loop's tick-timing wiring (collect measured, fences marked in tick before collection)
outcome: A test drives the real termal-persist writer loop (app_boot.rs) and shows that it measures the collect phase and marks pending fences as in a tick before collection, so dropping that wiring fails a test.
acceptance: Test the persist writer loop's tick-timing wiring (collect measured, fences marked in tick before collection) is done
